notes.title: Version and Publisher Changes
notes.notes:
Hey there folks,

During the last year or so Ground Control Studios was the "caretaker" of Hush on Steam, since there were plans for us to do a complete refactor of the game and fix its many issues.

That plan was due to kick-off after we finalize our work on other on-going games (Hyper Gods and two more).

However, Hush's owner and initial developer, GameStudio78 has different plans to the IP and requested that the game was returned to them. We were happy to oblige and so Hush is changing hands.

That change however will imply that the current version of the game is rolled back to a earlier demo. You will find that the gameplay is a bit different, some of you will provably like that version better, others won't, on either case it doesn't feature any save-games, Steam integrations and the level is different. 

So, 5 days from now (on Friday) we will upload the rollback and trigger an update to everyone. If you want to keep the current version, please disable "automatic updates" for the game on the library. If you want to try the "alternative" version, no action is required. Keep in mind that after the update there is no way to reverse to the current version.

And that's it folks, we are sorry to see this one go, but maybe it is for the best. We wish GS78 the best of luck on bringing this game back and we hope it does get ressurected and that you guys get the game you were hoping for!

Team Ground Control signing off!
